title: Find Duplicate Subtrees
description:
Given the root of a binary tree, return all duplicate subtrees.

Return each distinct duplicate subtree once as a level-order array of its values, using null for missing children and omitting trailing nulls. Sort the resulting arrays lexicographically (compare elements from left to right, with null before numeric values and shorter arrays first when one is a prefix). Return an empty array if none repeat.

Two trees are duplicate if they have the same structure with the same node values.

Example 1:

Input: root = [1,2,3,4,null,2,4,null,null,4]
Output: [[2,4],[4]]
Explanation: The duplicate subtrees are [2,4] and [4].

Example 2:

Input: root = [2,1,1]
Output: [[1]]
Explanation: The duplicate subtree is [1].

Constraints:

  • The number of the nodes in the tree will be in the range [1, 10^4]
  • -200 ≤ Node.val ≤ 200
